risk_factors.heading: We are subject to business continuity risks associated with increasing centralization of our information technology (“IT”) systems.
risk_factors.quote: If the centralized systems are disrupted or disabled, key business processes could be interrupted, which could adversely affect our business.

risk_factors.heading: A failure of or disruption in our information technology infrastructure, including a disruption related to cybersecurity, could adversely impact our business and operations.
risk_factors.quote: IT systems are vulnerable to disruptions, including those resulting from natural disasters, cyber-attacks or failures in third-party provided services.

risk_factors.heading: Our business success depends on attracting and retaining qualified personnel.
risk_factors.quote: any unplanned turnover or inability to attract and retain key employees and employees with engineering, technical and software capabilities in numbers sufficient for our needs could adversely affect our business.
